decisionReason: Deferred from N5 because source review verifies 分かつ|わかつ as a real common verb, but its share/divide usage is more written or formal than beginner-friendly 分ける. It should not stay in N5 only to close 分 -> わかつ coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 雨天|うてん as JLPT N1 and the rainy-weather/cancellation-register noun is too formal for beginner coverage.
Deferred from N5 because dictionary review marks 西瓜|すいか as usually written in kana; do not force rare kanji-form 西 -> すい coverage into the beginner word deck.
Removed from the default N5 word deck because 駅の前|えきのまえ is a transparent phrase. Keep it as example language and use the dictionary-backed word 駅前|えきまえ for a word-card identity.

Deferred from N5 because dictionary evidence verifies 休まる|やすまる as feeling rested or at ease, but this sense is less beginner-essential than 休む and 休み. Keep it for later word review instead of forcing 休 -> やすまる coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 下り|くだり as JLPT N3 and its downbound/train-direction sense is specialized. It should not stay in N5 only to close 下 -> くだり coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 長男|ちょうなん as JLPT N2. It is useful family vocabulary later, but N5 already has stronger beginner family anchors and should not force 男 -> なん coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 父母|ふぼ as later-level and the word is formal beside 父, 母, お父さん, and お母さん. Do not keep it only to cover 父 -> ふ.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 生かす|いかす as JLPT N1 and its make-use-of/keep-alive senses are abstract for beginner coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 南北|なんぼく as JLPT N2. N5 already teaches practical direction words, so 南 -> なん should wait for later word review.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 上り|のぼり as JLPT N2 and the upbound/train-direction noun is specialized. It should not stay in N5 only to close 上 -> のぼり coverage.

Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 外れる|はずれる as JLPT N2. It is common, but N5 already has stronger 外 coverage through 外|そと and core compounds, so 外 -> はずれる should wait for the later word deck instead of being forced as beginner coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 休める|やすめる as JLPT N1 and it is less beginner-friendly beside 休む|やすむ and 休み|やすみ. N5 should not keep it only to close 休 -> やすめる coverage.
Deferred from N5 because JLearn.net classifies 生やす|はやす as JLPT N1 and the grow/wear-a-beard sense is too narrow for a beginner anchor. N5 already teaches stronger 生 words such as 生まれる and 先生.

Deferred from N5 because dictionary evidence defines 下す|くだす around formal decision, judgement, verdict, and order senses. That is useful later, but it is not a beginner word-card anchor and should not be kept only to close 下 -> くだす coverage.

decisionReason: Deferred from N5 because source review shows scheduled lateness is usually 遅れる, while 後れる is better for falling behind, lagging, or bereavement senses. The old N5 bus-late card would teach a misleading spelling only to close 後 -> おくれる coverage.
